role = "hub"

# 🎮️ The stdio playgrounds: ONE row per app of the shipped document fleet, the way `block` ships
# block2d/3d/5d from one crate. Every row pins its own `app`, because a playground row that pins none
# boots `apps[0]` and reaches only that dialect's editor⇄viewer pair — `semio-tech play`'s coverage
# laws ("reaches every editor app a plugin descriptor declares" / "reaches every viewer app through
# its pane's editor⇄viewer switch") are satisfied exactly when every shipped app owns a row.
# `variant = "stdio"` stays the markdown row: it is the one app of the fleet that publishes an example
# and the lane `semio-tech play` activates the whole component from. Ports: the 6110/6210 pair markdown
# already held, plus one contiguous 6211–6218 / 6311–6318 block — every port below 6211 is claimed by
# another variant's react or wgpu launcher, and the catalog gate forbids sharing one.

aliases = ["stdio text"]

# 🪶️ Carried verbatim from the old `semio-s-app-puzzle-5d-engine` crate: the 5d wasm surface is built
# without `wasm-opt` (it miscompiles the brush/copy-paste session state), and that crate's cdylib has
# collapsed into this one.

wasm-opt = false

[package.metadata.wasm-pack.profile.release]
wasm-opt = false

[[package.metadata.semio.playground]]
variant = "puzzle2d"
compositionConfigPath = "✏️s/🧑‍💻dev/🧩️catalog/🧊️wgpu/🟦️.ts"
devContribution = "✏️s/🧑‍💻dev/🎭️variants/🧩️puzzle/🧬️schema/🔣️.json"
app = "s.puzzle.puzzle2d@1/*#editor"
aliases = ["2d", "puzzle 2d"]
ports = { react = 6012, wgpu = 6112 }
engines = ["./🌎️hub/🧩️compositions/🧩️puzzle/📦️packages/🦀️rust"]

[[package.metadata.semio.playground]]
variant = "puzzle3d"
compositionConfigPath = "✏️s/🧑‍💻dev/🧩️catalog/🧊️wgpu/🟦️.ts"

aliases = ["3d", "puzzle 3d"]
ports = { react = 6013, wgpu = 6113 }

[[package.metadata.semio.playground]]
variant = "puzzle5d"
compositionConfigPath = "✏️s/🧑‍💻dev/🧩️catalog/🧊️wgpu/🟦️.ts"
devContribution = "✏️s/🧑‍💻dev/🎭️variants/🧩️puzzle/🧬️schema/🔣️.json"
app = "s.puzzle.puzzle5d@1/*#editor"
aliases = ["5d", "puzzle 5d"]
ports = { react = 6014, wgpu = 6114 }

# 🎪️ The `aggregator` demonstrator row moved to
# ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎪️demonstrator/🪪️manifest/🗿️artifact/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/Cargo.toml — see that
# crate's docstring (REDUCE-DEMONSTRATOR-IDLE-MEMORY-FOOTPRINT). The asset rows below stay here too
# (copies also live on the bundle crate) since the standalone `puzzle3d` and `puzzle5d` dev variants
# need them independently of the demonstrator. `generatePlaygroundRegistry` keeps an asset row only
# when `asset.app` is absent or equals the playground row's own `app`
# (🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/📇️registry/🎮️playground/🔎️discovery/🟦️.ts), so every
# variant whose examples reach for `/mesh/*.glb` must name itself here — puzzle5d's World3d pane is
# built from the same mesh catalog as puzzle3d's.

route = "/mesh"
